question: To what kind of person is a particular thing to be given?
premises: A thing is marked as to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: The thing is to be given to one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: The thing to be given is not named in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
